card_stages.front: Pan es i drwy'r porth, roedd y brenin wedi marw. · Cyn marw, galwodd Uthr fi. · Ar ôl clywed … · Wrth gerdded drwy'r storm … · ers un ar ddeg o flynyddoedd
card_stages.back: When I went through the gate, the king had died. · Before dying, Uthr called me. · After hearing … · While walking through the storm … · for eleven years (with the present: and still)

entries.lemma: amdano fe / amdani hi · ato fe / ati hi · ohono fe / ohoni hi

senses.gloss_en: conjugated prepositions am (about), at (to), o (from, of) with he / she

card_stages.front: Dyn ni ddim yn gwybod dim amdano fe. · Cerddodd y ceffyl ato fe. · Daeth golau ohoni hi (y lleuad).
card_stages.back: We know nothing about him. · The horse walked to him. · Light came from it (the moon, f.). (am, at, o + fe / hi)

senses.gloss_en: by (agent of a passive); from (+ SM)

card_stages.back: by (agent of a passive); from (+ SM)

card_stages.front: Cafodd y neuadd ei glanhau gan y morynion. · Cafodd y bwrdd ei olchi. · Cafodd y llestri eu golchi. · Gafodd y gwin ei gario? — Do.
card_stages.back: The hall was cleaned by the maids. · The table was washed. · The dishes were washed. · Was the wine carried? — Yes. (ei + SM for g., ei + AM for b., eu for plural; gan + SM)

entries.lemma: dwedodd X fod … · gofynnodd X a / os …

senses.gloss_en: reported speech after a past verb: said that …; asked whether …

card_stages.front: "Mae'r cawr yn fawr." → Dwedodd e fod y cawr yn fawr. · "Dw i eisiau heddwch." → Dwedodd Arthur ei fod e eisiau heddwch. · "Ydy e'n gryf?" → Gofynnodd e a oedd e'n gryf.
card_stages.back: He said (that) the giant was big. · Arthur said (that) he wanted peace. · He asked whether he was strong. (dwedodd + fod; fi → ei fod e / ei bod hi; Ydy …? → a / os oedd …)

entries.lemma: taswn i …, baswn i … · tasai fe …, basai fe …

senses.gloss_en: conditional (imagined): if I were / did …, I would …

card_stages.front: Taswn i'n frenin, baswn i'n ymladd. · Tasai'r cawr yn gweld y farf, basai fe'n gwybod. · Faswn i ddim yn cwympo. · Os bydd angen … (efallai)
card_stages.back: If I were king, I would fight. · If the giant saw the beard, he would know. · I wouldn't fall. · If there is a need … (open condition: os + bydd / os ydy). (pe bai = tasai, in books)

senses.gloss_en: front (ar y blaen = in front, leading)

card_stages.back: front (ar y blaen = in front, leading)

senses.gloss_en: should / ought: dylwn i (I should), dylai fe/hi (he/she should), + soft mutation of the verb-noun

card_stages.front: Dylwn i fynd. · Dylai brenin arwain fel gŵydd. · Ddylwn i ddim hedfan ar y blaen drwy'r dydd. · (Gallwn i aros … hoffwn i aros)
card_stages.back: I should go. · A king should lead like a goose. · I shouldn't fly in front all day. · (I could stay … I'd like to stay — for recognition)

entries.review: [?] gender of lluwch for 'snowdrift'; plural lluwchfeydd

senses.gloss_en: recognising northern Welsh: the southern forms you use, and their northern partners

card_stages.front: De ↔ Gogledd: nawr ↔ rŵan · mas ↔ allan · llaeth ↔ llefrith · Mae ci gyda fi ↔ Mae gen i gi · e ↔ o, fo · eisiau ↔ isio · tad-cu ↔ taid · mam-gu ↔ nain
card_stages.back: Southern (what you say) ↔ northern (what you will hear): now · out · milk · I have a dog · he · want · grandfather · grandmother. Recognise the northern forms; keep using the southern ones.

entries.review: [?] gender of ffêr (f. in the plan; some sources m.)

entries.lemma: af i · gwnaf i · caf i · dof i; wna i ddim

senses.gloss_en: short-form future of mynd, gwneud, cael, dod (I'll go / do / get / come), = bydda i'n …

card_stages.front: Af i'n gyntaf. · Gwnaf i addo. · Cei di aros. · Down ni gyda'n gilydd. · Wna i ddim ymladd ar fy mhen fy hun.
card_stages.back: I'll go first. · I will promise. · You may stay. · We'll come together. · I won't fight on my own. (= bydda i'n mynd / gwneud …)

card_stages.front: ar fy mhen fy hun (ar dy ben dy hun)

entries.lemma: mae … yn cael ei … · bydd … yn cael ei …

senses.gloss_en: present and future passive with cael (is being / will be …-ed); literary gwelwyd = cafodd ei weld (recognition only)

card_stages.front: Mae'r stori'n cael ei dweud. · Bydd y stori'n cael ei chanu. · (cronicl: Gwelwyd y cawr. = Cafodd y cawr ei weld.)
card_stages.back: The story is (being) told. · The story will be sung. · (chronicle style: The giant was seen.)

entries.review: [?] tudalen gender: treated as f. (y dudalen) as in the plan; m. is also widely used

entries.lemma: Dw i'n gwybod y bydd …; y bwrdd mae pawb yn eistedd wrtho fe; lle; Ai …?

senses.gloss_en: 'that' + future (y bydd), prepositional relatives (… wrtho fe), lle 'where', and focus questions with ai

card_stages.front: Dw i'n gwybod y bydd pobl yn anghytuno. · Dyma'r bwrdd mae pawb yn eistedd wrtho fe. · bwrdd lle does neb yn eistedd ar y pen · Ai hwn yw'r pen?
card_stages.back: I know (that) people will disagree. · This is the table everyone sits at. · a table where nobody sits at the head · Is THIS the head?

entries.lemma: pan fydd … · pan ddaw'r amser · y brenin a fu ac a fydd

senses.gloss_en: pan + future (when … will); the glossed formulas pan ddaw'r amser (when the time comes) and y brenin a fu ac a fydd (the king who was and will be)

card_stages.front: Pan fydd angen brenin ar Gymru, byddi di'n deffro. · (pan ddaw'r amser · y brenin a fu ac a fydd)
card_stages.back: When Wales needs a king, you will wake. · (when the time comes · the king who was and will be)
